inputs.description: A tensor, the tensor to be updated.
constraints: If indices is a 2D tensor of shape (num_updates, n), then updates must be a (num_updates, inputs.shape[n:])-D tensor.
If indices is a 2D tensor of shape (num_updates, k), where k < n, then updates must be a (num_updates, inputs.shape[k:])-D tensor.

indices.description: A tensor or list/tuple of shape `(N, inputs.ndim)`, specifying indices to update. `N` is the number of indices to update, must be equal to the first dimension of `updates`.
constraints: N is the number of indices to update, must be equal to the first dimension of updates.
If indices is a 2D tensor of shape (num_updates, n), then updates must be a (num_updates, inputs.shape[n:])-D tensor.
If indices is a 2D tensor of shape (num_updates, k), where k < n, then updates must be a (num_updates, inputs.shape[k:])-D tensor.

updates.description: A tensor, the new values to be put to `inputs` at `indices`.
constraints: If indices is a 2D tensor of shape (num_updates, n), then updates must be a (num_updates, inputs.shape[n:])-D tensor.
If indices is a 2D tensor of shape (num_updates, k), where k < n, then updates must be a (num_updates, inputs.shape[k:])-D tensor.

output.description: A tensor, has the same shape and dtype as `inputs`.

constraints: If indices is a 2D tensor of shape (num_updates, n), then updates must be a (num_updates, inputs.shape[n:])-D tensor.
If indices is a 2D tensor of shape (num_updates, k), where k < n, then updates must be a (num_updates, inputs.shape[k:])-D tensor.
